name: lintel/starter
description: The zero-Rust first-run starter (M2 release-readiness): composer create-project lintel/starter my-app && cd my-app && php -S localhost:8000 renders a working page with NO Rust toolchain installed — the installer plugin fetches the prebuilt binary. This composer.json is consumed by create-project; for the local smoke (scripts/starter-smoke.sh) the path repositories pointing at php/lintel + php/runtime are added by the smoke script — the published starter resolves lintel/lintel + lintel/runtime from Packagist (DEFERRED-TO-MAINTAINER, named in the starter README).
